settings.text: This is the accessible entry to the system — the same engineering principles our pros run, packaged as a self-guided program you start the moment you buy. Follow the level, do the work, hit the numbers. Pick the level that matches your age and training experience; move up as you build.

settings.question: Do I need a gym?
settings.answer: Junior and U17 can be run largely with bodyweight and minimal equipment. From U19 up you'll need access to a barbell and basic strength equipment to load the strength blocks properly.

settings.question: How long is each level?
settings.answer: Each level is a multi-block program spanning roughly 8–12 weeks of structured work, plus retesting. Lifetime access means you can repeat blocks and re-run the program as you progress.

settings.question: How does the guarantee apply here?
settings.answer: Complete at least 80% of your level's sessions and supporting materials, follow the testing protocol, and if you don't see the measured result, we refund you. Adherence is the only variable.

settings.question: Which level should I choose?
settings.answer: Start from your age bracket, then adjust for training experience — a strong 16-year-old may belong in U19, a beginner senior may start at U17. The placement quiz removes the guesswork.
